Name: (CP) Craftable Qi seasoning
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[i]Two in one day ... this is not a record. [/i]

Anyways - this mod allows you to make Qi Seasoning right outside your own home!

After you earn it, of course. Mr.Qi wouldn't give that away for free.

I tried to make the implementation extremely lore friendly, and fit the style of the game - as well as putting use to a few things that don't really have much of a use.

[b][u]Recipe:[/u][/b]
1 Lemon Stone
1 Ancient Fruit
1 Truffle Oil

[b][u]How to get the Recipe:[/u][/b]
[spoiler] You need to complete the special order 'Qi's Cuisine' - the day after you complete it you'll get a letter in the mail letting you know that you can buy the recipe.[/spoiler]

[b][u]This mod is highly configurable, with options allowing you to change:[/u][/b]
- The amount of every ingredient
- How many Qi seasonings you get per craft
- How many Qi gems the recipe costs

[b]I highly recommend [/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][b] to edit this easily in game.[/b]


[u]Other Stuff:
[/u]- If you want to translate this just make sure to add this mod as a requirement when posting it to Nexus!
- I chose Lemon Stone because of the notes that it has in its description about it being rumored do be a 'dwarvish delicacy.'
- Truffle Oil also has the description of being a 'gourmet cooking ingredient' but it isn't used in cooking. 
- Ancient Fruit just felt right as a balancing item, as well as being something that, due to being so old, would add a unique but delicious flavor to something.

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url] - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b] ﻿

[i]Thank you to Button in the SDV discord for helping me with some token/condition stuff :)[/i]
